'''''Misopates orontium''''', known as '''weasel's snout''', is a [[herbaceous]] [[annual plant]] in the family [[Plantaginaceae]]. It is a native of [[disturbed ground]] in [[Europe]]. It is also naturalised as a [[weed]] in other parts of the world such as [[North America]]. The pink flowers resemble a miniature [[Antirrhinum|snapdragon]] and are followed by a hairy green fruit which is said to resemble a [[weasel]]'s snout.

Common names include '''linearleaf snapdragon''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=MIOR|taxon=Misopates orontium|accessdate=13 July 2015}}</ref> '''weasel's snout''', '''lesser snapdragon''' or '''calf's snout'''. Past common names have included '''lesser snapdragon''' and '''corn-snapdragon'''.<ref name="BrittonBrown1970">''[https://books.google.com/books?id=gUJLl95Gk8cC Gentianaceae to Compositae; gentian to thistle]''. Dover Publications; 1970. {{ISBN|978-0-486-22644-6}}. p. 179.</ref>

==Taxonomy==
Alternatively considered as the [[type species]] of section ''Orontium'', genus ''[[Antirrhinum]]''.
